erreurs.REQUETE_INVALIDE: Some information is invalid. Correct the highlighted fields and try again.
erreurs.NON_AUTHENTIFIE: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.
erreurs.IDENTIFIANTS_INVALIDES: Incorrect identifier or password. Check what you typed and try again.
erreurs.SESSION_EXPIREE: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.
erreurs.ACCES_REFUSE: You are not allowed to do this. Ask a manager.
erreurs.AUCUNE_ENTREPRISE: This account has no back-office access to any active business. Contact the owner of your venue.
erreurs.ENTREPRISE_SUSPENDUE: Access to this business is suspended. Contact Tonti support.
erreurs.RESSOURCE_INTROUVABLE: This item no longer exists or has been deleted.
erreurs.CONFLIT_MODIFICATION: This item was changed on another device. It has been reloaded: check it and try again.
erreurs.CODE_ETABLISSEMENT_DEJA_UTILISE: This code is already used by another venue. Choose another one.
erreurs.STOCK_INSUFFISANT: Not enough stock for this item. Remove it from the bill or choose another product.
erreurs.COMPTE_VERROUILLE: Too many failed attempts: the account is locked for a few minutes. Try again later.
erreurs.TROP_DE_TENTATIVES: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes before trying again.
erreurs.ERREUR_INTERNE: An unexpected error occurred. Try again; if it persists, give the code shown to support.
erreurs.RESEAU_INDISPONIBLE: The server cannot be reached. Check the connection and try again.
erreurs.CODE_APPAIRAGE_INVALIDE: Invalid or expired code. Ask the manager for a new code.

erreursAvecDelai.COMPTE_VERROUILLE: Too many failed attempts: the account is locked. Try again in {{duree}}.
erreursAvecDelai.TROP_DE_TENTATIVES: Too many attempts. Try again in {{duree}}.

vide.phrase: Order taking and checkout arrive in the next release, along with the product catalogue.
Today's sales, stock to watch and till sessions will show here from the first checkouts.

recu.phrase: Shared receipts arrive in the next release. Keep this link: it will remain valid.

introuvable.phrase: The address {{chemin}} does not match any screen. Check the link or go back to the home screen.

miseAJour.message: A new version of Tonti is available.

validation.codeFormat: 2 to 10 capital letters or digits, no spaces.
validation.motDePasseCourt: The password must be at least 8 characters long.
validation.contact: Enter a phone number or an email address.

connexion.phrase: With the phone number or email of your Tonti account.
connexion.identifiantAide: Phone: local number ({{pays}}), spaces optional. Other countries: start with “+” and the country code.
connexion.oubli: Forgot your password? Contact the owner of your venue.

validation.identifiant: Enter your phone number or email.

choixEntreprise.phrase: Your account gives access to several businesses. You can switch from the top bar.

vide.phrase: Add your first point of sale to open a till there.
vide.phraseSansDroit: Only a manager allowed to manage venues can add one.

formulaire.codeAide: 2 to 10 capital letters or digits, for example BE.

vide.phrase: Create the first client business: its owner will then be able to sign in.

entreprises.creeeCompteExistant: {{nom}} has been created and linked to the owner's existing account, who keeps their password.

suspension.consequence: Nobody will be able to sign in to this business and current sessions will be cut. You can reactivate it at any time.

reactivation.consequence: Its users will be able to sign in again.

formulaireEntreprise.telephoneAide: Local number ({{pays}}), spaces optional. Other countries: start with “+” and the country code.
formulaireEntreprise.contactAide: At least a phone number or an email: it is used to sign in.
formulaireEntreprise.codeAide: 2 to 10 capital letters or digits, for example BE.

inscription.phrase: Your business, your first venue and your owner account, all at once.

personnel.phrase: Each employee has one role per venue. The till opens with a PIN; the back office, with an account.

vide.phrase: Add your servers, cashiers and managers: each will get a PIN to open the till.

personnel.cree: {{nom}} has been added to the staff.

desactivation.consequence: {{nom}} will no longer be able to sign in, neither at the till nor in the back office, and open sessions will be closed. Their sales stay under their name.

pinConfirmation.consequence: The old PIN will stop working. A new temporary PIN will be shown once; it must be changed at the next till sign-in.

codes.consequence: Hand them over in person or in writing. They will not be shown again: they will be replaced at first sign-in.
codes.perdu: Lost code? “Reset PIN” generates a new one.
codes.compteExistant: This phone number or email already had a Tonti account: {{nom}} will sign in to the back office with their usual password and see {{entreprise}} among their businesses. Check with the person that it really is their number or email; otherwise, remove their access.

formulaire.rolesAide: One role per venue. Leave “None” where the employee does not work.
formulaire.adminAide: All rights, in every venue, including those opened later.
formulaire.accesAide: The chosen role allows it. Servers, cashiers and kitchen staff only use the till.
formulaire.accesImpossible: None of the chosen roles opens the back office: the employee will use the till with their PIN.
formulaire.accesSansRole: Choose a role first: the back office opens with the {{roles}} role.
formulaire.accesExistant: Signs in to the back office with {{identifiant}}.
formulaire.codesInfo: On saving, a temporary PIN is generated, and a temporary password if back-office access is given. They are shown only once.
formulaire.conflit: This employee was changed in the meantime: the form now shows the up-to-date information. Redo your changes.
formulaire.parEtablissement: Role per venue: manager, cashier, server or kitchen

motDePasse.phrase: This is your first sign-in: replace the temporary password with a personal one.
motDePasse.sessions: Your other open sessions will be closed.
motDePasse.different: The two passwords do not match.
motDePasse.change: Password saved. Sign in again with your new password.

tablette.phrase: A manager opens Tonti on their phone, in the back office: Tablets, then Register a tablet. They choose the venue and the name of this till, and get a 6-digit code. Type that code here.
tablette.etape1: The manager generates the code on their phone.
tablette.etape2: You type it on this tablet, within 10 minutes.
tablette.etape3: The tablet becomes a till of the venue: staff sign in with their PIN.
tablette.motDePasse: The manager’s password is never typed on this tablet.
tablette.aide: The code is submitted at the 6th digit. Expired or wrong code: ask the manager for a new one.

tablettes.phrase: Devices allowed to act as a till. A lost or stolen tablet is revoked here: it is cut off immediately.

vide.phrase: Register the tablet of each till: staff will sign in there with their PIN.

formulaire.nomAide: As staff will see it, for example “Till 1, bar”.

code.pour: For “{{nom}}”. On the tablet, open Tonti and type this code.
code.aTaper: Code to type on the tablet
code.attente: Waiting for the tablet: this screen updates once it is registered.
code.expire: This code expired without being used.

revocation.consequence: The tablet is cut off immediately: nobody can sign in on it any more. To reuse it, register it again with a code.

renommage.consequence: The new name shows on the tablet and in this list.
